tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content: **CryptoVault Banking** is a digital bank that stores highly sensitive customer financial records. They must ensure that all data is encrypted both in transit and at rest using customer-managed keys (CMK). The bank processes over 500,000 transactions daily across 12 geographic regions.

tabs.title: Encryption Requirements
tabs.content:
- Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) for Azure SQL Database must use a key stored in an Azure Key Vault Managed HSM for the highest level of hardware security.
- Disk encryption for all virtual machines must be enforced using Azure Disk Encryption (ADE), with an Azure Key Vault configured for the appropriate access policies.
- Access to the Key Vault must be restricted to specific service principals using Azure RBAC, ensuring that management plane access does not grant data plane access to keys and secrets.
